burgundy.name: Burgundy
burgundy.summary: Elegant, savory and high-acid; often more restrained than New World examples.

pinot-noir.expect: Elegant and high-acid, with red cherry, cranberry and earthy complexity.

chardonnay.expect: Tense, mineral and citrus-led, often with restrained oak and excellent acidity.

napa.name: Napa Valley
napa.summary: Ripe, generous and powerful, with plush fruit and elevated alcohol.

cabernet-sauvignon.expect: Full-bodied and ripe, with black fruit, cedar, substantial tannin and polished oak.

merlot.expect: Plush and ripe, with soft black fruit, rounded tannin and sweet oak spice.

bordeaux.name: Bordeaux
bordeaux.summary: Structured, savory and restrained compared with warmer New World styles.

cabernet-sauvignon.expect: Structured and savory, with blackcurrant, cedar, graphite and firm tannin.

merlot.expect: More savory and structured than plush New World Merlot, with plum, tobacco and earthy detail.

willamette.name: Willamette Valley
willamette.summary: Fresh and aromatic, balancing New World fruit with Old World restraint.

pinot-noir.expect: Fresh and aromatic, with cherry, raspberry and earthy spice framed by bright acidity.

barolo.name: Barolo / Piedmont
barolo.summary: Pale color, formidable tannin, aromatic complexity and long ageing potential.

nebbiolo.expect: Pale yet powerful, with soaring acidity, formidable tannin, rose, cherry, tar and truffle.

rioja.name: Rioja
rioja.summary: Savory red fruit and oak-aged complexity, often with vanilla and leather notes.

tempranillo.expect: Savory and polished, with cherry, plum, vanilla, leather and tobacco.

ribera.name: Ribera del Duero
ribera.summary: Dark, powerful Tempranillo with more density and ripeness than classic Rioja.

tempranillo.expect: Dense, dark-fruited and structured, with more power and ripeness than traditional Rioja.

priorat.name: Priorat
priorat.summary: Concentrated, mineral and powerful, often blending ripe fruit with slate-like character.

grenache.expect: Concentrated and mineral, with ripe red-black fruit, licorice and characteristic slate.

northern-rhone.name: Northern Rhône
northern-rhone.summary: Peppery, savory and aromatic Syrah with tension and smoked-meat complexity.

syrah.expect: Peppery and savory, with blackberry, olive, smoke and violet over firm structure.

barossa.name: Barossa Valley
barossa.summary: Ripe, dense and powerful Shiraz with generous fruit and alcohol.

syrah.expect: Rich and muscular, with ripe blackberry, plum, licorice and sweet oak spice.

mosel.name: Mosel
mosel.summary: Feather-light, high-acid Riesling with slate, citrus and remarkable ageing ability.

riesling.expect: Light-bodied yet intense, with piercing acidity, lime, peach and slate-like minerality.

marlborough.name: Marlborough
marlborough.summary: Vivid, aromatic Sauvignon Blanc with citrus, tropical fruit and herbal lift.

sauvignon-blanc.expect: Vivid and aromatic, with passionfruit, lime, gooseberry and grassy freshness.

loire.name: Loire Valley
loire.summary: Fresh, mineral and restrained styles with strong acidity and savory detail.

sauvignon-blanc.expect: Lean and mineral, with citrus, herbs and flinty freshness rather than tropical fruit.

chenin-blanc.expect: High-acid and versatile, with quince, apple, chalk and, with age, honeyed waxy complexity.

tuscany.name: Tuscany / Chianti Classico
tuscany.summary: High-acid, savory Sangiovese with sour cherry, herbs and earthy detail.

sangiovese.expect: Bright and savory, with sour cherry, herbs, leather and food-friendly acidity.

sonoma-coast.name: Sonoma Coast
sonoma-coast.summary: Pacific fog and wind preserve freshness while California sun gives ripe, polished fruit.

pinot-noir.expect: Silky and fruit-forward, with ripe cherry and raspberry balanced by coastal freshness.

chardonnay.expect: Ripe but fresh, often combining orchard fruit, citrus and restrained oak.

central-otago.name: Central Otago
central-otago.summary: High sunshine and large day-night swings create vivid fruit while retaining acidity.

pinot-noir.expect: Juicy and intense for Pinot Noir, with dark cherry, plum and bright acidity.

ahr.name: Ahr
ahr.summary: A northerly red-wine enclave producing delicate, high-acid Pinot with mineral and smoky detail.

pinot-noir.expect: Light, lifted and savory, with red fruit, smoke and brisk acidity.
